items.headline: 加沙近四分之一家庭由女性担任户主
items.headline_en: Women now head nearly one in four Gaza households
items.summary: 联合国妇女署估计，加沙约8.63万个家庭由女性担任户主，比例约为2023年10月前的两倍；其中近七成缺少合适住所。
items.summary_en: UN Women estimates that women now head about 86,290 Gaza households, twice the pre-October 2023 rate. Nearly seven in ten lack adequate shelter.

source.name: 联合国日内瓦办事处 / UN Geneva

items.headline: 前八个月中国货物贸易增长17.6%
items.headline_en: China's goods trade grows 17.6% through August
items.summary: 海关数据显示，前八个月货物进出口总值34.78万亿元；出口增长14.6%，进口增长22%，集成电路出口额增长95.4%。
items.summary_en: China's goods trade reached 34.78 trillion yuan through August. Exports rose 14.6%, imports 22%, and integrated-circuit exports 95.4% year on year.

source.name: 中国政府网 / 新华社

items.headline: AI绘出90亿种DNA变化的预测图
items.headline_en: AI maps 9 billion possible DNA letter changes
items.summary: DeepMind发布AlphaGenome Atlas，预测约90亿种人类DNA单碱基变化的分子影响。工具供学术研究免费使用，但仍需实验验证。
items.summary_en: DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas predicts the molecular effects of about 9 billion possible single-letter DNA changes. It is free for academic research, but still requires experimental checks.

items.headline: 强厄尔尼诺可能持续到明年2月
items.headline_en: Strong El Niño may persist through February
items.summary: 世界气象组织预测，厄尔尼诺持续到2027年2月的概率接近100%，并可能在年底达到很强水平，增加洪水、干旱和极端高温风险。
items.summary_en: WMO puts the chance of El Niño lasting through February 2027 at nearly 100%. It may become very strong by year-end, increasing the risk of floods, drought and extreme heat.

items.headline: 2025年全球学校遇袭事件增加33%
items.headline_en: Verified attacks on schools rose 33% in 2025
items.summary: 联合国教科文组织称，2025年经联合国核实的学校遇袭事件有1680起，比2024年增加33%。9月9日是保护教育免受攻击国际日。
items.summary_en: UNESCO says the UN verified 1,680 attacks on schools in 2025, up 33% from 2024. The figures mark the 9 September day protecting education from attack.

items.headline: 中国U20女足世界杯首战5比0取胜
items.headline_en: China open U-20 Women's World Cup with a 5-0 win
items.summary: 中国队在U20女足世界杯小组赛首战5比0击败新喀里多尼亚。黄嘉欣12分钟内上演帽子戏法，替补陈瑞琳贡献4次助攻。
items.summary_en: China opened the U-20 Women's World Cup with a 5-0 win over New Caledonia. Huang Jiaxin scored a 12-minute hat-trick and substitute Chen Ruilin made four assists.

previous_answers.headline:
六个人中，为什么一定能找到三位熟人，
或三位互不认识的人？
previous_answers.headline_en: Why must six people contain three mutual acquaintances or three mutual strangers?
previous_answers.explanation:
任选一人 A。其余五人中，至少有三人都认识 A，或至少有三人都不认识 A。

若 A 认识 B、C、D，其中任何两人认识，就与 A 组成三位熟人；若三人之间无人相识，B、C、D 就是三位陌生人。若 A 不认识 B、C、D，其中有两人互不认识，他们与 A 组成三位陌生人；否则 B、C、D 彼此认识。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
Choose any person A. Among the other five, at least three all know A, or at least three all do not.

If A knows B, C and D, a connected pair among them gives three mutual acquaintances with A. If there is no such pair, B, C and D are mutual strangers. If A knows none of them, an unconnected pair gives three mutual strangers with A; otherwise B, C and D all know one another.
previous_answers.subject: 上周证明题

previous_answers.headline:
单位长绳随机剪两刀，
三段能围成三角形的概率是多少？
previous_answers.headline_en: A unit string is cut at two random points. What is the probability that the three pieces form a triangle?
previous_answers.explanation:
设两刀位置为 0 < x < y < 1，三段长度为 x、y - x、1 - y。三段能成三角形，当且仅当每段都小于 1/2。

所有 (x, y) 构成面积为 1/2 的三角形。满足 x < 1/2、y > 1/2、y < x + 1/2 的区域面积为 1/8。因此概率为 (1/8) ÷ (1/2) = 1/4。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
Let the cuts be 0 < x < y < 1. The pieces have lengths x, y - x and 1 - y. They form a triangle exactly when every piece is shorter than 1/2.

All possible pairs (x, y) fill a triangle of area 1/2. The region satisfying x < 1/2, y > 1/2 and y < x + 1/2 has area 1/8. The probability is therefore (1/8) ÷ (1/2) = 1/4.
previous_answers.subject: 上周概率题

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上周思考题 · 示例估算 / LAST WEEK · SAMPLE ESTIMATE
previous_answers.headline:
北滘镇一个工作日，
大约会有多少单外卖？
previous_answers.headline_en: Roughly how many food-delivery orders are placed in Beijiao on a weekday?
previous_answers.result: 约 5 万单 / 工作日
previous_answers.explanation:
一组假设：北滘工作日常住及通勤人口约25万，其中60%会用外卖；这部分人平均每周点2单，按5个工作日均摊。

25万 × 60% × 2 ÷ 5 = 6万单。再用约1800名活跃骑手、每人每天25单核对，得到4.5万单。因此可估为约5万单，合理范围是4万到6万单。
previous_answers.explanation_en:
One set of assumptions: about 250,000 residents and commuters are in Beijiao on a weekday; 60% use food delivery and place two orders per working week. This gives 250,000 × 60% × 2 ÷ 5 = 60,000 orders.

A cross-check using 1,800 active riders at 25 orders each gives 45,000. A reasonable estimate is therefore about 50,000, with a range of 40,000 to 60,000.
